en.title: Beaver Lamp Pro
en.descriptionHtml:
No More Working in the Dark – Keep Both Hands Free

You know how it is. You're leaning over the engine bay, or crouched down in the boat fixing something that simply has to be done. The light doesn't reach far enough. The torch is in the wrong place. Your phone dies.

It shouldn't be like that.

With the right head torch you work efficiently, see every detail and skip the frustration. No hassle. Just clear, steady light exactly where you need it.

The Solution – Powerful, Lightweight and Built to Be Used

This rechargeable head torch gives you wide 270° work lighting and a focused spotlight that reaches up to 200 metres.

Whether you're:

  • Working on the car in the garage

  • Fixing electrics or the engine in the boat

  • Tinkering late at night

  • Working in tight spaces

  • Out camping or fishing

… you've got the right light, straight away.

It weighs just 100 grams and sits comfortably thanks to soft silicone and an adjustable strap. You'll barely notice you're wearing it.

And yes, you can switch it on and off with a wave of your hand in front of the light. Perfect when your hands are dirty.

Features & Specifications

Brightness:

  • 1500 lumens total

  • 1000 lm from 3 COB LEDs (wide 270° lighting)

  • 500 lm from XPE spotlight (up to 200 m range)

5 light modes:

  • COB – full power

  • COB – medium

  • XPE – full power

  • XPE – medium

  • COB + XPE – flashing mode

Battery & charging:

  • Built-in 2200 mAh lithium battery (3.7V)

  • 3–4 hours at full power

  • Up to 6 hours with normal use

  • Fast charging via USB-C (2.5–3 hours)

  • Red indicator while charging

  • Flashes red at low battery

  • Green light when fully charged

Other:

  • Motion sensor (on/off with a hand wave at approx. 10 cm)

  • IP45 – withstands rain and moisture

  • Material: Flexible silicone

  • Colour: Black

  • Adjustable size – fits all

  • USB-C cable included

For Those Who Want to Work Smarter

This isn't a toy. It's a tool.

With the right light you work faster, safer and more accurately. Less frustration. Better results.

Perfect to keep in the car, boat, toolbox or garage – always ready when you need it.

Buy With Confidence – 30-Day Return Guarantee

Try it yourself, no pressure.
You have a 30-day return guarantee if it doesn't meet your expectations.
